CORAM: HON'BLE SMT. JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI  ORAL JUDGMENT Aggrieved by the award passed in M.V.C.Nos.4122/2017, 4123/2017 dated 10.11.2021 by the Chief Judge, Court of Small Causes, Member Principal Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru,

sentences.text: both the claimant and insurance company are before this Court.

The claimants' appeals are MFA.Nos.8167/2022 and 8188/2022 and the insurance company's appeals are MFA Nos.3614/2022 and 3548/2022.
2.

On 03.11.2016, at about 07.00 pm., when the petitioners Aishwarya, Sanjana, Mallesh were standing in front of Goli Vada Pav Shop on 22nd Main, 22nd Cross, BSK 2nd Stage, Bengaluru, at that time, a Ford car No.KA.05/MT.8865 came in high speed, rash or negligent manner and dashed against the two wheeler No.KA.02/EY.6320 at the first instance, and after NC: 2025:KHC:31244 that car proceeded further and dashed to Aishwarya, Sanjana and gone inside Goli Vada Pav Shop and dashed to Mallesh and caused damage to the shop.
In the said accident, Sanjana, Smrithi Anand, rider of the two wheeler Krishna Nadig, Mallesh have sustained severe injuries and Goli Vada Pav shop has been damaged.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submits that the Court has granted the exorbitant amount as compensation without considering the evidence on record, when the disability in MVC No.4122/2017 is only a disfigurement and the Court has considered the loss of future earning capacity.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the claimants submits that in MVC No.4122/2017 claimant/respondent has undergone splenectomy and it would have lot of complications in her life.
Learned Counsel for the insurance company submits what is the impact of that surgery on the claimant?
No doctor is examined on his behalf.
Even in MVC No.4123/2017, claimant/respondent has undergone pancreatectomy, the claimants have not examined by the doctors.

sentences.text: Considering the submission of both the learned counsels, this Court deems it appropriate to set aside the award in MVC Nos.4122/2017 and 4123/2017 and remand the matters to the Tribunal for fresh consideration.

Accordingly, this Court is passing the following:
i.

The appeals in MFA.No.8167/2022, MFA.
No.3548/2022, MFA.No.3614/2022, MFA. No.8188/2022 are allowed and the award passed by the Chief Judge, Court of Small Causes, Member Principal Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru in MVC No.4122/2017 and MVC No.4123/2017 is set aside and both the cases are remanded back to the Trial Court for fresh consideration.
ii.

entities.text: Court of Small Causes, Member Principal Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is open to both the parties to raise their respective contentions, objections and adduced additional evidence if any with regard to compensation.
iii. Registry is directed to return the Trial Court Record to the Tribunal along with the certified copy of the order passed by this Court forthwith without any delay.
iv. The amount in deposit shall be forthwith transferred to the Trial Court and the same shall NC: 2025:KHC:31244 be kept in fixed deposit till the disposal of the case.
v. No Costs.

vi. Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand  closed.
 SD/-
 (LALITHA KANNEGANTI)
